scope: Five in-memory component recovery checks and three real-workspace browser-control checks; two loaded-backend compatibility checks. No user document mutations.

Browser storage refusal and simultaneous multi-tab draft editing were not browser-qualified.
Recognition accuracy, bilingual meaning and long-document workloads remain separate qualification tasks.
